name: Southwest® Rapid Rewards® Plus Credit Card
effective_cost: Low if you check a bag or are chasing the Companion Pass
balance_transfer_fee: Either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater
penalty_apr_trigger: Failing to make a Minimum Payment when due, or making a payment that's returned unpaid; can remain in effect indefinitely
pay_over_time_fee: Up to 1.72% per month of the amount selected to pay over time, via Chase Pay Over Time

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $1,000 in purchases in the first 3 months from account opening

verdict.text: Cheapest way onto the free-bag list and Companion Pass stacking

earn_note: The weakest earn structure in the Southwest lineup: same 1× base as Premier and Priority, with no dining or travel-portal bonus at all. This card earns its keep through the free bag, Companion Pass boost, and low fee, not through how it earns points. Gas and grocery spend combine toward a single $5,000/yr cap before dropping to 1×.

points.note: No blackout dates or seat caps: every seat Southwest sells is bookable with points. Southwest moved to dynamic pricing in March 2025, so the exact cent value now floats with fare demand instead of sitting on a fixed award chart.

transfer_partners.highlight: Rapid Rewards points only redeem for Southwest travel (or a short list of gift-card/merchandise partners at poor value); there's no way to move them to another airline or hotel program.
transfer_partners.recent_changes: Closed-loop currency, unchanged in structure across all three Southwest personal cards. Chase Ultimate Rewards can convert into this account, but nothing moves out of it.

credits.name: Free Checked Bag
credits.subtitle: 1st bag · you + up to 8 on reservation
credits.description: Southwest ended free checked bags for everyone on May 28, 2025 ($35 first bag / $45 second bag on most fares). Rapid Rewards cardmembers keep their first checked bag free, for the cardholder and up to 8 companions on the same reservation.
tips: Only the first bag is free on this card. Southwest's own A-List Preferred members and Choice Extra fares get a free second bag too; this tier doesn't.
It covers everyone on the reservation, not just the cardholder: a family checking one bag each on a round trip can clear a big chunk of the $99 fee in a single trip.

insurance.detail: Secondary (domestic) / primary outside the US · $60k · 31 days
Not offered on any Southwest personal card

protection_note: Thin, typical of an entry-level co-brand: no trip cancellation/interruption coverage at any Southwest tier, and rental car coverage is secondary domestically (primary only outside the US). The $500,000 common-carrier travel accident policy and baggage delay/loss coverage are the real safety net here.
rental_note: Secondary for domestic rentals (pays after your own auto policy), primary only outside the US, capped at $60,000 and 31 consecutive days. Decline the counter's CDW and pay with the card, but don't rely on it as your only coverage for a US rental.

status_perks.name: Companion Pass progress
status_perks.note: A 10,000-point boost toward the 135,000 Companion Pass qualifying points needed each year, identical across all three Southwest cards, so it's not a reason to pick this tier over Premier or Priority.

status_perks.name: A-List tier points
status_perks.note: This card earns zero Tier Qualifying Points toward A-List status from card spend; Premier and Priority are the tiers that build status.

status_perks.name: Boarding position
status_perks.note: Group 5 boarding for the cardholder + up to 8 companions on the reservation, same slot as Premier and Priority. Real A-List members still board ahead of all three in the A1–A15 range.

services.name: Seat selection
services.detail: Complimentary Standard seat selection within 48 hours of departure, when available, for you + up to 8 companions on the reservation.

services.name: Anniversary bonus
services.detail: 3,000 Rapid Rewards points automatically deposited every account anniversary.

services.name: Annual flight discount
services.detail: One 10% off promo code each cardmember year, delivered within 15 days of your anniversary; excludes Basic fares.

services.name: Inflight purchase credit
services.detail: 25% back as a statement credit on Southwest inflight food, drinks and Wi-Fi purchases.

services.name: Partner perks (through 2027)
services.detail: 3-month complimentary Instacart+ trial and 12-month complimentary DashPass (activate by Dec 31, 2027); 2× Rapid Rewards points on Lyft rides through Dec 2027.

services.name: No foreign transaction fees
services.detail: Zero FX fees on international spend.

services.name: Roadside assistance
services.detail: Pay-per-use dispatch service (towing, tire change, jump start, lockout, fuel delivery) available 24/7 in the US and Canada; you pay a pre-negotiated per-service fee.

services.name: Travel & emergency assistance
services.detail: Legal and medical referrals while traveling; cardholder pays for any goods or services obtained.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

benefits.text: Earns Rapid Rewards on their spend (into your account)
Own card number, contributes to the account's Companion Pass and A-List progress
Free-bag and boarding perks come from being booked on the same reservation, not from authorized-user status

additional_cards.note: Authorized users are free on all three Southwest personal cards. The free checked bag and Group 5 boarding apply to whoever is booked on the same reservation as the cardholder (up to 8 people). You don't need to add someone as an authorized user for them to get it, just book them on your itinerary.

timeline.text: Southwest ended free checked bags for all passengers ($35 first bag / $45 second bag on most fares); this card's free first bag went from a redundant perk to a real one overnight.
Fee raised $69 → $99; gained the free checked bag, Standard seat selection, Group 5 boarding, and partner perks (Instacart+, DashPass, Lyft points).
Legacy benefits from the old card structure (2 EarlyBird Check-In credits and 2× points on internet/cable/phone) were discontinued.
